mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, it is a clear 65 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. We are under a Waning Gibbous moon tonight.
The city reminds residents that alternate side parking rules start November 20 to assist with snow removal, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

We have a busy couple of days! Today features yoga at Insight Wellness, Art House 360 events, and Hop Haus trivia. Tomorrow, check out live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-or-Treat at Hometown Junction Park.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation where a man was found behind the wheel and subsequently arrested for an O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
